reponse:
It’s still targeted for December 1, but I wouldn’t call it fully on track yet: as of November 17, IdP-initiated login works on staging, while SP-initiated login fails because Fernhill is signing with RSA-SHA1; the team asked them to switch to SHA-256. [1]

Before launch, Fernhill needs to make that change, then both login paths need end-to-end validation. [1] The SSO settings page is on staging, but its copy still needs review; JIT provisioning is part of the December 1 scope, and I don’t see confirmation that it’s complete. [1] The ticket sets December 1, 2026 as the go-live date. [1]
